subject: LAB-004
title: Start, pause, and undo the demo session, then reset the demo and start it again
provenance: Original synthetic script written for this project's LAB-004 qualification replay and distributed under its MIT License. Its seed is a byte-for-byte copy of the app's demo seed, Fixtures/demo/seed.json, and its session ID is the one the app, its widget, and its Controls share.
untested: The widget, the Controls, and the App Intents: the replay submits each change to OperationService as the adapter it is composed with, and never runs an intent type, WidgetKit, or the snapshot file.
A stale toggle: the runner counts a conflict receipt as a step that did not pass, so a stale surface's conflict is proved by the SurfaceDeck package and Mac hosted qualification tests instead.
The snapshot, its redaction, and its stale indicator: the replay writes no snapshot and draws no surface.
Host views and the receipt list: the replay renders nothing.
Physical devices and the iOS, watchOS, and tvOS simulators: the replay runs in the package test process on the Mac.

steps.description: Reset Demo creates the 12 original samples. There is no session yet: it has never been started.
Start the session, as the deck's Start Session or a toggle that showed a never-started session does. It is created, running, at revision 1.
Pause the session from the revision a surface showed, 1. It is paused at revision 2.
Undo the pause with the operation its receipt recorded. The session runs again at revision 3.
List the Pigment swatches collection by title: the session's changes touched no sample.
The person confirms Reset Demo a second time.
Reset Demo pauses the running session at its next revision, 4, and removes nothing.
Start the session from the paused state the reset left, revision 4. It runs at revision 5.
